CustomObject.description: One event in the life of a charge point that § 37 MessEG cares about. The Eichfrist is not an eight-year timer - the industry counts more than 45,000 re-calibrations a year against an assumed 6,000, driven by cable replacement, maintenance and theft. So calibration status is computed from a chronology of events, and this object is that chronology. § 37 distinguishes three paths with three different consequences, which is why Typ__c is restricted and why three formula checkboxes derive the consequence rather than a person typing it.
CustomObject.label: Eingriff
